description:
Use when someone asks what is new at Moda, whether a Moda group is down, or about a recent launch, event or announcement.
count: optional number of posts, 1 to 10 (default 5).
Returns JSON: notices for any Moda group that is temporarily down and the group to use meanwhile, then the newest posts from The Feed (modacommunities.com/updates), each with its date, kind, title, a short summary and its link.
name: get_moda_news
title: Get Moda's latest news
